route: Official Supermetrics apps for Claude and ChatGPT, backed by vendor-hosted Supermetrics MCP
read: Discover connected sources, accounts and fields; retrieve cross-channel marketing performance. Campaign inspection and research tools are available on supported ad platforms.
write: Create paused campaigns, change budgets/status/settings, edit ads and remove campaigns on supported platforms. Publish Supermetrics Studio dashboards. This is no longer a reporting-only route.
setupDetails: Connect the directory app with OAuth, then authorise data sources. Remote MCP is also available at https://mcp.supermetrics.com/mcp. Writing requires an additional account-level opt-in.
access: AI chats or MCP entitlement/trial, Campaign management entitlement and seat where applicable, connected accounts with platform edit permission. The connection owner enables writes for each account/team.
limitations: Campaign management covers Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat and ChatGPT Ads, not every reporting connector.
Write access starts disabled. Approval policy is configurable; do not claim every change always requires human confirmation. New campaigns start paused.
Ad editing differs by platform; some edits create a replacement ad. Snapchat creative editing is not supported. Campaign removal is irreversible.
Platform eligibility, quotas and supported campaign formats still apply. Documentation verification does not prove an individual account can use every action.

write: Can execute configured SQL or database administration tools when enabled and permitted. Create/update/delete support depends on database, exposed tools, credentials and read-only configuration; it is not a ready-made ad-platform connector.
setupDetails: Run the Toolbox binary/container locally or deploy it, configure data-source access and toolsets, then connect an MCP client. Prebuilt configurations reduce coding but not database administration.

limitations: Do not substitute Google Cloud's distinct managed remote MCP products for this self-managed Toolbox entry.

route: Snowflake-managed MCP server with explicitly configured Cortex, SQL and custom tools

write: SYSTEM_EXECUTE_SQL is read-only by default; writes require changing that configuration and sufficient role privileges. Configured UDFs/stored procedures can perform actions. Tool annotations alone are not enforcement.
setupDetails: A Snowflake administrator creates an MCP server object and exposes approved tools; clients connect using OAuth or other supported authentication. Snowflake hosts the server.
access: Snowflake account, warehouse/data, configured semantic views/search/agents as relevant, and separate permissions for both server and underlying tools.
limitations: Managed hosting does not mean zero-configuration business access.
Writes exist only through exposed and authorised tools; no general campaign management is implied.
Generated SQL and executed SQL must be distinguished.
